description: This Java class 'DefaultClusterConfig' provides a default implementation of the 'ClusterConfig' interface, managing cluster configuration settings such as the number of shards and a blocklist of cluster status roles. It includes methods to instantiate the configuration from a Typesafe Config object, as well as standard Object methods like equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: DefaultClusterConfig
classes.description: Immutable class that loads cluster configuration parameters such as number of shards and role blocklist from a provided Config.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultClusterConfig from a Config object.

methods.name: getNumberOfShards
methods.description: Returns the number of shards configured.

methods.name: getClusterStatusRolesBlocklist
methods.description: Returns the cluster status roles blocklist.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on configuration properties.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on configuration properties.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the configuration.
